tips.text: Use Alpha Strike on monsters to clear camps faster; it deals bonus damage to them. Basic attacks between casts bring it back sooner.
Cast Wuju Style before you start attacking a camp or an enemy, since it adds true damage to every attack while it lasts.
Use Meditate to heal after a camp or a trade. It heals more the lower your health is, and you take less damage while channeling.
Do not use Meditate while Alpha Strike is in progress, because it is disabled then. Wuju Style and Highlander can still be cast.
Save Alpha Strike for the fight itself. You can't be targeted while it runs, so it is a good way to jump in on a carry.
Activate Highlander when a fight starts. It removes slows, and each champion takedown makes it last longer and cuts your other cooldowns.
Stay away from enemies with stuns or roots, because Highlander does not protect you from them. Wait for them to use those skills before you dive in.
Keep hitting the same target to build up Double Strike. Every third attack strikes twice.

combos.name: Alpha Strike exit direction
combos.when: Use it when you want to choose which side of the target you land on, such as to dodge a skillshot or step toward a wall.
combos.text: While you are vanished, click or right-click to pick the direction you reappear in from the target. Only your last command counts.

tips.text: Cast Highlander when Aatrox's Infernal Chains is on cooldown; it clears any slow they put on you and you can't be slowed while it lasts.
Use Alpha Strike as a dodge; you can't be targeted while it plays out, so cast it as The Darkin Blade comes down.
Walk out of The Darkin Blade's edge or sideways; the knock up only comes from its sweetspot, so don't stand in it.
Fight Aatrox while Meditate is ready; it cuts the damage you take and heals you back up when he trades with you.
Aatrox heals when he hits you, so burst him with Wuju Style and Alpha Strike rather than trading slowly.

comboRefs.note: Choosing your Alpha Strike landing side lets you step away from Aatrox's Darkin Blade line.

tips.text: Use Highlander when Ambessa tries to slow you with Lacerate; you cannot be slowed while it lasts and you can run her down.
Do not stand still in Meditate while Ambessa is close. Her Public Execution can still grab you from far away.
Jump away with Alpha Strike to dodge her big hits, since you cannot be targeted while you jump. Use a minion or another enemy as the target.
Turn on Wuju Style just before you trade, so your attacks deal extra damage that armor cannot reduce.
Her Repudiation shield makes early trades poor, so wait until it is spent or on cooldown before you go in.
Stay away from Amumu while Curse of the Sad Mummy is ready; being stunned in his reach usually costs you the fight.
Highlander does not free you from a stun, so keep it for chasing, not for dodging Bandage Toss.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable, so use it to avoid Amumu's Bandage Toss or Curse of the Sad Mummy when you see it coming.
Amumu takes less physical damage from Tantrum, so do not expect easy trades. Pick on his allies and avoid a long fight with him.
Use Highlander when Bel'Veth tries to slow you down; you shrug off slows, so you can chase her or run away.
Save Alpha Strike for after her Above and Below has been used; you vanish and can't be targeted while it plays out.
Fight her before she gets Lavender stacks and her true form; her attack speed and damage grow the longer the game runs.
Do not stand still in a long brawl with her; Royal Maelstrom gives her damage reduction and life steal, so burst her down instead.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable while you dash, so use it to dodge Brand's Pyroclasm or Pillar of Flame once you see him commit.
Turn on Highlander before Brand casts Pyroclasm; you can't be slowed, so its slow does nothing to you.
Brand's Sear stuns you if you are already ablaze, so don't stand in his line after he hits you with another spell. Step out of the fireball's path.
Use Meditate to heal and cut damage when Brand's burn is ticking on you, but not while his stun is about to land.
Get on Brand fast and stay on him. He is squishy, and Wuju Style adds true damage to your attacks while you chase him down.
Hold Alpha Strike until Briar has used Head Rush. While you vanish you can't be targeted, so you can dodge her stun and her forced attacks.
Save Highlander for when Briar tries to slow you. It clears slows and keeps you free of them while it lasts.
Do not fight Briar while she is stunning you. Keep Meditate for when she is not close; it cuts the damage you take but she still heals from her bleed.
Fight her when her Head Rush is on cooldown. Use Wuju Style at the start of the trade so your attacks deal extra true damage.
Do not fight Darius when he has stacked bleeds on you. Noxian Guillotine finishes you from far away, so back out of the fight before you are low.
Highlander makes you immune to slows, so use it when Darius tries to chase you or slow you with Crippling Strike. It will not stop Apprehend from pulling you.
Wait until Apprehend is on cooldown before you jump in with Alpha Strike. Being pulled and knocked up in the middle of a fight will get you killed.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable, so use it to dodge Noxian Guillotine or to get out of Decimate's swing.
Stay out of Decimate's swing. Its heal is biggest when it hits several enemies, so do not stand next to your allies in a fight.
Don't rely on Highlander to escape Moonfall. It stops Diana's slow, but she still pulls you in and the beam still lands on you.
Use Alpha Strike to become untargetable when Diana dashes in with Lunar Rush, so you avoid her burst.
Use Meditate when Diana commits her burst. It cuts the damage you take and heals you, but she can still reach you.
Hit Diana with Wuju Style attacks when she fights you, because it deals true damage that her shield doesn't absorb.
Wait for Pale Cascade's shield to run out or be used up before you commit to a fight with Diana.
Sidestep Crescent Strike when you can. Being hit by it lets Diana reset Lunar Rush and chain onto you.
Cast Highlander before Dr. Mundo's Infected Bonesaw lands; with it active you can't be slowed, so you can still chase him.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable as you jump, so use it to dodge the bonesaw's damage while closing in. Don't use it to run away from a fight you can't win.
Kill Dr. Mundo fast when you fight him, because if he gets time to use Maximum Dosage, he heals through your damage.
Wuju Style deals true damage, so turn it on before you hit him. It ignores his health and the sturdiness he gets from items.
Don't Meditate right next to him. His Heart Zapper hurts nearby enemies and heals him when he detonates it.
Use Highlander when Ekko's Timewinder or Parallel Convergence would slow you; you ignore slows, so you can still chase him down.
Don't chase Ekko once his Chronobreak is ready. He can rewind and undo your whole fight.
Stay out of the Parallel Convergence circle when it lands. It stuns only if Ekko steps inside, so watch where he walks.
Hold Alpha Strike until Ekko's stun zone is spent or you are clear of it. Alpha Strike disables movement for its whole cast.
Use Meditate to cut damage when Ekko bursts you, but not while stunned or in range of Chronobreak's blast.
Cast Highlander when Evelynn's Allure lands on you; you cannot be slowed, so it removes the slow and speeds you up to run or chase.
Evelynn's Allure shows an arrow toward her once the mark is fully formed, so look for it and move away before she gets the charm.
Stay near your minions or camps when you can; Alpha Strike can jump to them, and Evelynn is weak when she has to fight you head on.
Save Alpha Strike for when she dives in with Last Caress or Whiplash; you cannot be targeted while it runs, so her single-target hits miss.
Finish her off with Wuju Style attacks once she is low; Last Caress hits harder on low-health targets, so Evelynn will want to hit you before that.
Wait for Fiddlesticks to use Reap or Terrify before you dive; without them he has little to stop you.
Use Highlander when you engage so Reap can't slow you. Fear and silence can still stop you.
Fiddlesticks can pretend to be an effigy; be wary of standing still in brush or near objectives where he may be hiding.
Don't Meditate inside Bountiful Harvest range; he can interrupt you and heal off you. Alpha Strike out first if you need to escape.
Cast Highlander before Graves can use Smoke Screen on you; while it is active you cannot be slowed, so the smoke will not catch you.
Graves is strongest when you stand in front of him, so hit him with Alpha Strike and attack right away. Don't walk up in a straight line.
Use Meditate once you are hurt and away from his shotgun, since it cuts the damage you take while you heal.
Turn on Wuju Style before your first hit on Graves so your attacks deal extra true damage. His armor from Quickdraw will not reduce it.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable while you jump, so use it to dodge Collateral Damage when you see him aim it.
Use Highlander before Gwen's Needlework lands; it clears slows from you and you can't be slowed while it lasts.
Don't chase Gwen when she is inside Hallowed Mist; she can't be targeted from outside it, so Alpha Strike has nothing to hit.
Wait out the Mist, which lasts only a short time, then jump in with Alpha Strike once she is targetable again.
Turn on Wuju Style just before you fight her; the true damage ignores the armor she gains from Hallowed Mist.
Take fights before Gwen has built up her attacks; she needs several hits to set up her damage.
Use Highlander when Hecarim fears or slows you; you shrug off slows, but his fear can still stop you, so save it for after the fear ends.
Hold Meditate for when Hecarim's Spirit of Dread is on you; it cuts the damage you take while you heal.
Use Alpha Strike to dodge Devastating Charge: you can't be targeted while you vanish, so cast it as he commits.
Fight Hecarim before he builds speed; Wuju Style on, then focus him, because he is sturdy but you out-damage him in a long fight.
Keep Alpha Strike ready for when Hecarim uses Onslaught of Shadows on your team, then jump to his squishy teammates away from the fear.
Dodge nothing and trust Highlander: when Ivern's Triggerseed would slow you, activate it first, because you can't be slowed while it lasts.
Ivern's Rootcaller is his only way to hold you in place, so be ready to use Alpha Strike on a minion or monster to get away if you are rooted.
Fight Ivern before Daisy is out. If she is on the field, go after Ivern or kill him fast, because her third hit on you knocks you up.
Chase Ivern only when his Rootcaller is on cooldown. Dodge the vine and he has little left to stop Master Yi's damage.
Check brush before you walk in; Ivern's Brushmaker makes ambush spots and lets him and his allies hit harder from inside.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard; Dragon Strike pulls him along it and knocks you up.
Use Highlander when Jarvan slows you with Golden Aegis; it clears slows and you ignore them while it lasts.
Do not rely on Highlander once Cataclysm lands; its walls still trap you, so save Alpha Strike to hop out onto a target outside.
Use Meditate when Jarvan commits; it cuts the damage you take while you heal.
Wait until Counter Strike ends before you hit Jax; he dodges every basic attack during it, then stuns anyone close.
Do not rely on Alpha Strike to hit Jax while he is in Counter Strike; the strikes are dodged, though Alpha Strike still makes you untargetable.
Jax gets much stronger the longer he keeps hitting you. Use Alpha Strike to jump in and out in short bursts instead of trading blows.
Turn on Highlander when Jax tries to slow or chase you; it clears slows and stops new ones, but not stuns.
Use Meditate to reduce damage when Jax goes all in, but not if you are about to be stunned by Counter Strike.
Use Highlander when Jayce knocks you back or slows you; you shrug off slows and can chase him down.
Jump on Jayce with Alpha Strike when he is in Cannon form and cannot swing back hard, then keep hitting him.
Turn on Wuju Style before you trade with Jayce; the true damage ignores the armor he gains in Hammer form.
Save Meditate for when Jayce bursts you; it cuts the damage you take while you heal.
Dive Karthus with Alpha Strike when he has no allies near; it makes you untargetable while you jump in, so his Lay Waste can't hit you mid-jump.
Turn on Highlander before you step into Wall of Pain; you can't be slowed, so the wall won't slow you.
Kill Karthus fully and walk away from his corpse. His spirit form keeps casting, and Defile hurts anyone standing close.
Karthus is weak when caught by you up close. Hit him with Wuju Style active so your attacks deal extra true damage before he can fight back.
Gank when Karthus is channeling Requiem; he can't move or cast other abilities while channeling.
Cast Highlander before Kayn can pin you down; you can't be slowed, so Blade's Reach no longer stops you from chasing.
Kayn's knock up from Blade's Reach still works on you in Darkin form, even during Highlander. Stay out of its line.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable, so use it to dodge Kayn's Umbral Trespass when he jumps onto you.
Hit Kayn with Alpha Strike when he is in the open, then chase. He can only escape through walls for a short time once he is hurt.
Use Meditate to heal and take less damage when Kayn commits to a fight. It is a good answer to his burst.
Cast Highlander when Kha'Zix tries to slow you with Unseen Threat or an evolved Void Spike; you shrug off slows and run him down.
Stay near your allies or minions when Kha'Zix is around. Taste Their Fear hits much harder on a lone target.
Use Meditate when Kha'Zix jumps on you; it cuts the damage you take and heals you, but do not start it while stunned or pinned in a kill.
Chase Kha'Zix with Alpha Strike once Leap is on cooldown; he has no easy way out then.
Kindred is fragile, so jump on her with Alpha Strike and kill her before Wolf's Frenzy and Mounting Dread help her.
Mounting Dread slows you, but Highlander removes slows and blocks new ones. Activate it when she tries to kite you.
Stay in Meditate while Kindred's Lamb's Respite is up. Nobody inside can die, so save your burst until it ends.
Don't chase Kindred inside the Wolf's Frenzy area. Wolf bites whoever she last attacked, so fight her when it is down.
Hold Alpha Strike until Lee Sin has used Sonic Wave or Tempest, so you can dodge his kick setup and escape with the untargetable jump.
Turn on Highlander before Lee Sin's Tempest follow-up lands; you can't be slowed while it lasts, so Cripple won't stop your chase.
Lee Sin can still root you with Dragon's Rage, even in Highlander. Keep distance from him when his ultimate is ready.
Use Meditate to cut damage when Lee Sin ganks or invades. It reduces damage and heals you, but you can't move while channeling.
Keep Highlander for when Lillia has used Swirlseed; it stops her slow, and her sleep is her best answer to you.
Do not run at Lillia while she is marked with her Lilting Lullaby ready; being put to sleep leaves you open to your whole enemy team.
Use Alpha Strike on a minion to land at a safe distance when you expect Watch Out! Eep!
Don't chase Wukong while Cyclone is spinning; it knocks you up. Wait for it to end, then start your fight.
Use Alpha Strike on a minion or monster rather than Wukong if his clone is near. Strikes on the wrong target waste your damage.
Turn on Highlander when Wukong tries to run or to slow you down. It makes you immune to slows, so you can chase him.
Use Meditate to take less damage when Wukong dives in. Don't start it while Cyclone is about to hit you.
Hit the real Wukong after Warrior Trickster. The clone deals reduced damage, so aim your attacks at the one that moved.
Cast Highlander when Naafiri's Hounds' Pursuit hits you; you shake off the slow and can run her down.
Use Alpha Strike on a Packmate or minion near Naafiri if you need to dodge her burst; you can't be targeted while it plays.
Hold Meditate for when Naafiri bursts you; it cuts the damage you take and heals you while you channel.
Switch on Wuju Style before you fight her; the extra true damage ignores her Armor.
Dodge Javelin Toss early; Nidalee's damage and her chase both start from that hit, and it hurts most from far away.
Use Highlander when Nidalee tries to slow or chase you; it clears slows and stops new ones.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable, so use it to dodge her Pounce or Swipe when she jumps on you.
Walk carefully through brush and near objectives; Bushwhack traps are invisible and hurt over time.
Hold Meditate for when she bursts you down. It cuts the damage you take and heals you.

comboRefs.note: Choosing your landing side while vanished helps you step away from or past Nidalee's Javelin Toss.

tips.text: Nocturne's Shroud of Darkness blocks the next enemy Ability. Bait it with a cheap spell first, and save Alpha Strike until it has run out.
When Nocturne casts Unspeakable Horror on you, break the tether by getting out of range, or use Alpha Strike. Otherwise you are feared.
Highlander stops Nocturne's slow from the end of Unspeakable Horror, but not the fear. Do not rely on it to save you from the tether.
Stay near your team when Nocturne casts Paranoia. His dash cannot be stopped, so a lone Yi is an easy target.
Use Meditate to reduce Nocturne's burst when he jumps on you. You cannot cast it in the middle of Alpha Strike.
Stay out of Absolute Zero's slow if you can. Highlander cleanses slows and blocks new ones, so save it for when the blizzard starts.
Do not run in a straight line from Biggest Snowball Ever!. Use Alpha Strike on a minion or monster to jump out of its path.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable, so use it to dodge Consume when you see Willump begin the bite.
Do not stand where Snowball Barrage can hit you. Being hit by all three slows you, and the delayed root can follow.
Use Meditate to heal after a poke trade, not when you are about to be stunned. It is a channel that gets interrupted.
Don't stand in front of Pantheon while he braces Aegis Assault; he ignores damage from that side. Wait it out or step around behind him.
Turn on Highlander before Pantheon's Shield Vault lands so his Grand Starfall slow can't stop you.
Keep your health up. A thrown Comet Spear hits much harder on low-health targets.
Use Meditate to take less damage when Pantheon jumps on you. Don't cast it into a stun and expect to move.
When you see Grand Starfall start, move out of its area. Pantheon takes a while to land, so don't stay in it.
Use Alpha Strike on a minion or monster to close in when Qiyana is not alone; it also keeps you untargetable while you jump.
Turn on Highlander before you fight her; you can't be slowed, so her river root-then-slow from Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal only hurts if she lands it first.
Her Supreme Display of Talent stuns, and Highlander does not stop stuns. Hold Alpha Strike to dodge it, since you are untargetable while jumping.
Use Meditate to survive her burst when you are low; it heals more the lower you are and cuts the damage you take.
Turn on Wuju Style before you start hitting her; the bonus true damage ignores her armor.

comboRefs.note: Choosing your landing side while untargetable helps you avoid Qiyana's Edge of Ixtal slash or land away from her.

tips.text: Don't run in on Rammus when Defensive Ball Curl is up; attacking him hurts you. Look for other targets or wait for it to end.
Keep your distance when Frenzying Taunt is ready. Being taunted stops you from picking your target and leaves you open to his team.
Slows don't work on you during Highlander, so use it when Rammus's Powerball or Soaring Slam would otherwise catch you.
Rammus is a poor target for your damage, so use Alpha Strike on his squishier teammates instead.
Powerball stuns and knocks back what it hits, so don't stand in his path while you're channeling Meditate.
Cast Highlander when Rek'Sai's Unburrow knocks you up or she chases you; it clears slows, though it does not stop the knock up.
Use Alpha Strike to dodge Void Rush; it makes you untargetable, so time it for when she is about to land.
Use Meditate to survive her burst, but not while she is next to you with Furious Bite ready at full Fury.
Her Prey Seeker lands on the first enemy it hits, so stay out of a straight line with her in the jungle.
Stay out of brush when Rengar is near; he leaps from it, and he can leap on you while camouflaged.
Highlander makes you immune to slows, so use it when Rengar's Bola Strike would otherwise slow you.
Rengar's Bola Strike roots instead of slowing when he has full Ferocity. Do not rely on Highlander then; fight when his Ferocity is low.
Use Alpha Strike to dodge Rengar's leap or his burst; you cannot be targeted while it runs.
Use Meditate when Rengar jumps on you; the damage reduction cuts his burst. He can still cleanse or root you, so do not rely on it alone.
Cast Highlander before Sejuani's Glacial Prison or Winter's Wrath lands; it clears slows and stops new ones, though it won't save you from stuns.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable while you jump. Use it to dodge Permafrost when she has four stacks on you.
Alpha Strike does not add Permafrost stacks to you. Do not chase her with melee allies beside her, because their attacks stack Permafrost.
Sidestep Arctic Assault; it knocks you up and sets up her stun. Fight her when it is on cooldown.
Use Meditate to heal and cut damage only when no stun is coming; it is useless once you are stunned.
Walk around Shaco's hidden boxes when you can. Stepping on one makes you feared and rooted, and Highlander won't stop that.
Turn on Highlander when Shaco's Two-Shiv Poison slows you. It clears the slow and stops more from landing.
Alpha Strike is a good answer when Shaco jumps in. You can't be targeted while it plays, and it lets you hit him and get away.
Use Meditate to take less damage when Shaco bursts you. Start it before his damage lands, because you can't cast it during Alpha Strike.
Keep Wuju Style ready for a fight. Its true damage hurts Shaco no matter how much armor he has.
Cast Highlander when Shyvana slows you with Molten Burst; you shrug off slows and can run her down or escape.
Do not use Alpha Strike to dodge her Dragon's Descent. Hold it until she lands so you can jump on her afterward.
Turn on Meditate when she bursts you down; it cuts the damage you take and heals you while you channel.
Fight her while she has little Dragon Fury. Without it she cannot transform, and Master Yi wins the early duel by hitting fast.
Cast Highlander before Skarner's Seismic Bastion or Shattered Earth lands; it clears slows and makes you immune to them while it lasts.
Skarner's Impale and Ixtal's Impact stop you cold, so keep Alpha Strike ready to dodge them. You cannot be targeted while it runs.
Do not trade into Skarner for long. His attacks stack Quaking and hurt more the longer you stay, so burst him and leave, or heal with Meditate.
Turn on Wuju Style before you start hitting Skarner. The bonus true damage ignores his tanky build.
Cast Highlander before Sylas can slow you; it clears slows, though Abduct can still stun you, so keep Highlander for when his Abduct is on cooldown.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable while it runs, so use it to dodge Sylas's Kingslayer or Hijack if he commits to you.
Once Sylas has used Abduct, go in with Alpha Strike. He has no quick way to stop you.
Do not meditate while Sylas has his spells ready; Meditate cuts damage and heals, but he can wait it out and burst you when it ends.
Sylas can steal Highlander and use it himself, so do not hand him a free steal when you are far ahead and fighting him alone.

comboRefs.note: Choosing your reappear side lets you step out of line of Abduct's thrown chains after Alpha Strike.

tips.text: Save Highlander for when Talon uses Rake; it makes you immune to the slow, so you can keep chasing.
Use Meditate to heal and take less damage when Talon bursts you, but only once his Noxian Diplomacy is spent.
Fight Talon with Wuju Style already active so your attacks add true damage the moment he engages.
Talon is fragile, so use Alpha Strike on him or a nearby target to dive in and hit him quickly.
Talon can vanish with Shadow Assault, so use Alpha Strike or Highlander's speed to stay on him.
Don't fight Trundle inside his Frozen Domain; he hits much faster and runs faster there. Wait until he leaves it, or pull the fight elsewhere.
Turn on Highlander before Trundle can slow you with Chomp or Pillar of Ice; it makes you immune to slows and clears any you already have.
Don't Alpha Strike into a fight beside Trundle's Pillar of Ice without thinking. The pillar is terrain, so it can block your path and your escape.
Trundle's Chomp lowers your Attack Damage, so don't trade for long. Use Meditate to heal and reduce damage once he has hit you.
Use Wuju Style right before you start hitting Trundle, since its bonus damage ignores his armor. His Subjugate adds armor to him, so true damage helps.
Cast Highlander before Udyr's Wingborne Storm slows you; while it lasts you can't be slowed and you can run him down.
Udyr's Blazing Stampede attack stuns on contact, so don't stand in front of him when it is ready. Fight him when that stun has been used.
Use Meditate when Udyr hits you hard; it cuts the damage you take while you heal.
Jump away with Alpha Strike when Udyr is closing in. You can't be targeted while you jump.
Turn on Wuju Style before you trade; the extra true damage ignores the Armor Udyr's shield-based build gives.
Keep Highlander ready for Vi's Cease and Desist; it cleanses slows but not the knock up, so don't count on it to save you once she has you.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable, so use it on a nearby minion or monster when Vi is about to dash at you with Vault Breaker.
Don't trade for long with Vi. Her third hit with Denting Blows cuts your Armor and speeds up her attacks.
Use Meditate when Vi's burst is spent; it cuts the damage you take while you heal.
Keep Highlander for when Viego has used Spectral Maw; the stun is the main thing that stops you, and Highlander does not remove it.
Use Alpha Strike to dodge Viego's Heartbreaker or Spectral Maw; you cannot be targeted while you vanish.
Kill Viego fast with Wuju Style on, since his Blade of the Ruined King heals him as he trades with you. Do not drag out a fight.
Hold Meditate for when he commits; it cuts the damage you take. Do not cast it while Spectral Maw is ready, as it can be stunned.
When Viego kills someone, hit him before he consumes the wraith, since he is untargetable while winding up.
Save Alpha Strike for when Volibear's Thundering Smash is spent; while it is up he can stun you the moment you land.
Do not count on Highlander to escape his Sky Splitter and Stormbringer. It stops you being slowed, but they still deal heavy damage.
Use Meditate to cut the damage when Volibear jumps on you. Do not start it while he can stun you, because a stun interrupts it.
Fight him away from his Frenzied Maul mark. Break off after he bites once, because the second hit heals him.
Turn on Wuju Style before you trade, so your attacks deal true damage that his extra health does not reduce.
Meditate won't save you once Infinite Duress lands, because you are suppressed. Stay out of his leap line while Alpha Strike is ready.
Do not fight Warwick when you are low on health. Blood Hunt lets him sense you and chase you down fast.
Use Alpha Strike on a nearby minion to dodge Jaws of the Beast; you cannot be targeted while you vanish.
Hit Warwick with Wuju Style attacks; true damage cuts through his damage reduction from Primal Howl.
Back away when Primal Howl ends, because it makes you feared. Highlander does not stop fear, so stay out of range.
Do not rely on Alpha Strike to escape Xin Zhao; his charge and slow catch you quickly once you land.
Use Meditate when Xin Zhao's attacks start landing; it cuts the damage you take and heals you.
Keep Highlander for after Xin Zhao has used his knock up and slow; it makes you immune to slows.
Turn on Wuju Style before you trade with Xin Zhao; it adds true damage to your attacks.
Cast Highlander before Zac's Stretching Strikes lands; you can't be slowed, so his slow won't stop you from chasing.
Zac's Elastic Slingshot ends in a knock up and stun, so stay out of its landing zone once you see him charging.
Kill every bloblet when Zac splits apart; if any survive he comes back. Alpha Strike can hit several of them.
Step on Zac's goo chunks so he can't heal from them, especially after he hits you with an ability.
Use Alpha Strike to dodge Zac's Stretching Strikes or Elastic Slingshot; you can't be targeted while you jump.
Use Meditate to heal and take less damage when Zac's burst lands, but not while he's about to stun you.
Cast Highlander when Zed slows you with Shadow Slash; it clears slows and stops new ones, so you can chase him down.
Zed's Death Mark makes him untargetable while he dives in. Use Meditate once the mark is on you to cut the damage when it triggers.
Stay close to Zed with Alpha Strike when his shadow is out. He is weaker right after Living Shadow, so jump on him then.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable as you jump, so use it to dodge Zed's Razor Shuriken.
Stepping on Zyra's seeds destroys them, so walk over them before she can turn them into plants.
Use Highlander before you fight Zyra; her Vine Lashers can't leave you slowed while it lasts.
Grasping Roots will leave you rooted, and Highlander doesn't stop that. Stay out of its line until it's used, then jump in.
Alpha Strike makes you untargetable while it plays out. Use it to get in on Zyra, and use it on a minion to land at a safe distance.
Zyra's plants are weak and expire quickly. Go for Zyra herself rather than chasing plants.
Use Meditate to heal through Zyra's poke when you're hurt, but not while her root is ready.
